name: mnemosyne
description: Long-term memory for Claude Code across sessions and repos, on its own private copy of the Mnemosyne Memory engine and its own store.

scope.title: Memory scope
scope.description: global: one memory shared by every repo. per-project: each repo keeps its own, and facts saved as global are seen everywhere.

memoryDir.title: Memory store
memoryDir.description: Leave empty for the default: ~/.claude/mnemosyne/store (macOS, Linux) or %USERPROFILE%\.claude\mnemosyne\store (Windows). Or give an absolute path, or one starting with ~/.

rememberTerms.title: Remember terms
rememberTerms.description: Leave empty for the defaults: remember:, remember that, note that, save to memory. A prompt starting with one of these asks Claude to save the rest. Type none to turn this off.

recallTerms.title: Recall terms
recallTerms.description: Leave empty for the defaults: recall:, what do you remember about, check memory. A prompt starting with one of these looks up memories for it. Type none to turn this off.

externalMcp.title: Share with other MCP clients
externalMcp.description: Off by default. On: writes ~/.claude/mnemosyne/bin/mnemosyne-mcp (mnemosyne-mcp.cmd on Windows), a stdio MCP server other tools (Cursor, Codex, claude mcp add) can use with this memory. Off removes it.
